items.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.summary_en: Kimi introduces the K3.1 Pro line and a Highspeed variant, focusing on faster inference and practical AI workloads. The writeup highlights trade-offs between speed, power, and cost for developers deploying models at scale.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了 Kimi 的 K3.1 Pro 系列及 Highspeed 变体，聚焦于更快的推理性能及对 AI 工作负载的适用性。讨论了在大规模部署中，速度、功耗与成本之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
items.title_zh: 今天，我们破解了本来要破解的目标：iPhone
items.summary_en: We hacked the iPhone as planned, detailing the approach and lessons learned. The post underscores ongoing mobile security challenges and how defenders adapt to evolving techniques.
items.summary_zh: 作者按计划攻破了 iPhone，给出实现细节和经验教训。此事凸显移动设备安全的持续挑战及对抗者与防御者之间的博弈趋势。

items.title_en: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
items.title_zh: 谷歌称可能将Gmail和Google Photos数据用于定向广告
items.summary_en: Google hints it may use Gmail and Photos data to target ads, broadening the signals that feed its advertising system. The move fuels privacy concerns and could draw scrutiny from regulators.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌表示可能使用Gmail与Google Photos中的数据来定向广告，扩大广告系统依赖的个人信号。这一举动引发隐私担忧，可能引来监管机构的关注。

items.title_en: Dessa: the most authentic full-duplex speech model ever built
items.title_zh: Dessa：有史以来最真实的全双工语音模型
items.summary_en: Dessa delivers a full-duplex speech model that can listen and respond in real time, enabling seamless back-and-forth dialogue with very low latency. The development moves us toward truly conversational AI for consumer devices, customer support, and collaborative tools.
items.summary_zh: Dessa 推出一款能够实时听说的全双工语音模型，能实现极低延迟的实时对话。此项进展将使消费设备、客服与协作工具中的人机对话更自然，极大提升交互体验。

items.title_en: Investor-owned utilities charge 23% more for electricity than public providers
items.title_zh: 私营公用事业向用户收取的电价比公立提供者高出23%
items.summary_en: Electricity prices charged by investor-owned utilities run about 23% higher than public providers. The gap highlights how privatization and regulatory structures influence consumer costs, even as reliability and service quality may vary. For tech and energy teams budgeting for grid usage and energy-intensive workloads, the differential matters for planning and resilience.
items.summary_zh: 投资者所有的公用事业公司电价比公营提供者高出约23%。这一差距揭示了私有化与监管框架如何影响消费者成本，即便可靠性和服务质量也会有所不同。对于需要用电的技术团队和能源密集型工作负载而言，这一差异在预算、规划与韧性设计上具有显著影响。

items.title_en: Apple Music 404 Not Found
items.title_zh: Apple Music 404 未找到
items.summary_en: An instance of a broken Apple Music link surfaces, prompting questions about reliability and content routing on streaming platforms. The note underscores the fragility of URL-based content discovery.
items.summary_zh: 发现 Apple Music 的一个链接返回 404，暴露出流媒体平台在内容发现与路由方面的脆弱性。

items.title_en: CVE Tracker
items.title_zh: CVE 跟踪器
items.summary_en: A centralized tracker for CVE disclosures, helping security teams monitor vulnerability severity, affected products, and disclosure timelines. It supports prioritization and remediation planning across complex software stacks.
items.summary_zh: 一个集中化的 CVE 漏洞信息跟踪工具，帮助安全团队监控漏洞的严重程度、影响产品和披露时间表。便于在复杂的软件堆栈中进行修复优先级排序与整改计划。

items.title_en: We are all living inside of an obscure sci-fi film from 1970
items.title_zh: 我们都活在1970年代的一部冷门科幻片里
items.summary_en: The piece argues that today’s media and tech landscape feels like living inside a 1970s sci-fi film, with surveillance, corporate power, and speculative tech shaping our reality. By drawing parallels between retro-futurist tropes and current systems, it challenges readers to question tech narratives.
items.summary_zh: 本文认为当下的媒体与科技景象仿佛让人身处1970年代的一部冷门科幻片，监控、企业势力与前沿科技正在塑造现实。通过对比复古科幻与现今系统，它促使读者反思科技叙事中的现实扭曲。

items.title_en: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
items.title_zh: 本地维基：只收录你步行半小时内的事物
items.summary_en: A concept for a Wikipedia-like wiki restricted to items within a 30-minute walk of your location, enabling hyperlocal crowdsourcing. This model foregrounds privacy and relevancy, but raises questions about coverage, updates, and shared standards across communities.
items.summary_zh: 一个近场本地维基的设想，只收录你所在位置半小时步行范围内的条目，强调超本地化的众包协作与隐私保护。此思路提升信息相关性，但也带来覆盖范围、更新频率和跨社区标准化等挑战。

items.title_en: eMudhra ignored Mozilla Root investigation deadline; blames social media
items.title_zh: eMudhra 忽视 Mozilla 根证书调查截止日期；将责任归咎于社交媒体
items.summary_en: eMudhra missed Mozilla root investigation deadline and blamed social media; the incident highlights accountability and timelines in CA/PKI oversight and trust. It underscores regulatory expectations for certificate authorities.
items.summary_zh: eMudhra 未能在 Mozilla 根证调查的截止日期内完成回应，并把责任归咎于社交媒体，凸显证书颁发机构在监管与信任框架中的问责与时限要求。

items.title_en: Docker is weird
items.title_zh: Docker 真奇怪
items.summary_en: Explores oddities in Docker's behavior that catch developers off guard, from image layering and build caching to volume mounting quirks. The post offers practical tips to avoid common pitfalls and explains why these quirks persist in modern container tooling.
items.summary_zh: 揭示 Docker 行为中的一些反直觉之处，比如镜像分层、构建缓存和卷挂载的怪异之处。文中给出实用的排错技巧，解释了这些怪异现象在现代容器工具中的持续原因。

items.title_en: Securing our frontier model training environment
items.title_zh: 保护前沿模型训练环境
items.summary_en: OpenAI outlines security practices for a frontier model training environment, focusing on data privacy, access control, secure software supply chains, and monitoring. The guidance aims to reduce risk during large-scale model development.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 提出前沿模型训练环境的安全实践，涵盖数据隐私、访问控制、软件供应链安全与监控，旨在降低大规模模型开发过程中的风险。

items.title_en: Can we replace a $150k Looker with a bucket of HTML files?
items.title_zh: 用一桶 HTML 文件能替代价值 15 万美元的 Looker 吗？
items.summary_en: A provocative take arguing that BI tooling like Looker can be replaced with static HTML artifacts and lightweight dashboards, challenging the ROI of premium BI platforms. It spotlights a DIY data ethos.
items.summary_zh: 提出用静态 HTML 文件和轻量仪表盘替代 Looker 等高价 BI 工具的观点，挑战高端 BI 平台的投资回报，并凸显自建数据可视化的趋势。

items.title_en: Disney Raising Prices Days After Confirming Ads Will Now Show Up on Every Tier
items.title_zh: 迪士尼在确认所有价位都将显示广告后提高价格
items.summary_en: Disney+ is raising prices shortly after confirming ads will appear at all tiers, signaling a tighter monetization strategy that blends ads with subscription value. The move could nudge subscribers toward ad-supported options or prompt churn among price-sensitive users, affecting the streaming market.
items.summary_zh: 在确认所有套餐都将包含广告后，迪士尼提高了订阅价格，反映出其对广告与订阅相结合的盈利策略。此举可能促使部分用户转向带广告的方案，或让价格敏感用户流失，影响流媒体市场格局。

items.title_en: Quad9 to exit France
items.title_zh: Quad9 将退出法国
items.summary_en: Privacy-focused DNS resolver Quad9 announces it will discontinue services in France, citing regulatory and operational challenges. The move underscores how geopolitical and local privacy laws shape the reach of privacy-centric infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Quad9 宣布退出法国市场，原因涉及监管与运营挑战。这一举动凸显了地缘政治与地方隐私法规对隐私基础设施覆盖的影响。

items.title_en: Florida officer found dead man, impersonated him for years, renovated his home
items.title_zh: 佛州警官在发现死者后冒充其身份多年并翻新住宅
items.summary_en: A Florida deputy allegedly used the identity of a dead man for years and even renovated the deceased’s home. The case raises questions about accountability and potential abuse of power within law enforcement.
items.summary_zh: 据称，一名佛州警官在得知一名死者后长期冒充其身份，甚至翻新了对方的住宅。此案凸显执法机构内问责与权力滥用的潜在问题，正在接受调查。

items.title_en: UUIDv7 doesn't have the properties you think it does
items.title_zh: UUIDv7 并不具备你想当然的属性
items.summary_en: UUIDv7 is commonly assumed to be time-ordered and unique in a certain way; the piece shows why those expectations are wrong and when you should pick alternatives. It clarifies behavior that can affect databases and distributed systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章揭示 UUIDv7 常被误以为具备的特性其实并非如此，解释在分布式数据库和系统中为何需要谨慎使用以及何时应选用其他方案。

items.title_en: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business
items.title_zh: eMudhra 将退出全球 SSL/TLS 证书业务
items.summary_en: eMudhra says it will exit its global SSL/TLS certificate business, signaling a strategic retreat from a crowded CA market. The move could nudge customers to migrate to other providers and accelerate consolidation in the PKI ecosystem, with ripple effects on how organizations manage trust chains.
items.summary_zh: eMudhra 宣布将退出全球 SSL/TLS 证书业务，显示其在竞争激烈的证书颁发机构市场中的战略收缩。此举可能促使客户转向其他供应商，并推动公钥基础设施生态的整合，对组织的信任链管理产生连锁影响。

items.title_en: OpenSSL 4.1.0
items.title_zh: OpenSSL 4.1.0 发布
items.summary_en: OpenSSL 4.1.0 arrives with security fixes, feature updates, and API changes, continuing to shape TLS security in software.
items.summary_zh: OpenSSL 4.1.0 发布，包含安全修复、功能更新与 API 变更，持续影响软件的 TLS 安全。

items.title_en: How is music possible
items.title_zh: 音乐为何会存在
items.summary_en: The piece sketches how physics, perception, and cognition combine to produce music, from sound waves to rhythm and harmony. It helps readers appreciate the scientific underpinnings of why music moves us.
items.summary_zh: 文章从物理、感知与认知角度解释音乐如何产生，涵盖声波、节奏与和声等要素，帮助读者理解音乐为何能打动人心。

items.title_en: Google will pay people to use less electricity so its data centers can use more
items.title_zh: 谷歌将付费激励用户减少用电以便数据中心多使用清洁能源
items.summary_en: Google pilots payments to reduce electricity use during peak times, enabling data centers to run more when cleaner energy is available. This demonstrates demand-response strategies at tech scale.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌试点通过支付激励，促使用户在高峰时段减少用电，以便数据中心在清洁能源可用时进一步运行。这体现了科技规模的需求响应策略。

items.title_en: German court calls Google aerial imagery 'spying'
items.title_zh: 德国法院将谷歌的航拍影像定性为监视行为
items.summary_en: A German court ruled that Google's aerial imagery constitutes spying, highlighting privacy and data collection tensions in mapping services. The decision could influence regulation of street-level data collection in Germany.
items.summary_zh: 德国法院裁定谷歌的航拍影像构成监视行为，凸显地图服务中的隐私与数据收集之争。此判决可能影响德国对街景数据收集的监管走向。

items.title_en: Ask HN: If the models are so good, why doesn't OpenAI just start 100 companies?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：如果模型真的如此强大，OpenAI 为什么不直接开设100家公司？
items.summary_en: Raises strategic questions about whether AI models can autonomously spawn new companies, touching on execution, regulation, and business risk. Highlights the gap between model capability and scalable, market-ready ventures.
items.summary_zh: 提出若 AI 模型真的如此强大，为何不能由 OpenAI 自行孵化出大量新公司，探讨执行、监管与商业风险，并指出模型能力与可扩展市场之间的差距。

items.title_en: Gemma-4-26B-A4B with 39-69% less thinking at same accuracy
items.title_zh: Gemma-4-26B-A4B：在同等准确度下减少 39-69% 的推理
items.summary_en: A claim that Gemma-4-26B-A4B achieves significantly lower thinking requirements at the same accuracy, signaling efficiency gains for AI deployments. The note discusses implications for latency, cost, and safety.
items.summary_zh: 称 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 在保持同等准确度的前提下，推理成本降低 39-69%，展现了部署效率的潜力，并影响时延、成本与安全性考量。

items.title_en: No Source Code? No Problem
items.title_zh: 没有源代码？没问题
items.summary_en: The piece argues that software provenance and behavior can be understood even without source code, exploring techniques like binary analysis, instrumentation, and behavior-based security. It emphasizes practical implications for defenders and researchers.
items.summary_zh: 文章指出即使没有源代码，也能通过二进制分析、动态分析与行为驱动的安全方法来理解软件行为。强调对防守方与研究人员在受限或闭源软件场景下的实际应用。

items.title_en: I turned my TV into a Game Boy Color with a Pokemon town as my home screen
items.title_zh: 我把电视改造成 Game Boy Color，并把宝可梦小镇设为主屏
items.summary_en: A playful hardware mod turns a TV into a Game Boy Color-inspired hub, using a Pokemon town as the home screen. It showcases DIY ingenuity and the charm of retro-style interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 一个有趣的硬件改造项目把电视变成 Game Boy Color 风格的主屏，以宝可梦小镇作为首页，展现了DIY 创意与复古界面的魅力。

items.title_en: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
items.title_zh: 大语言模型让形式化软件验证在更大规模上成为现实
items.summary_en: Large language models are making formal verification scalable beyond niche research by automating proof steps and suggesting invariants. This lowers the manual burden of proving software correctness and expands the range of verifiable systems—from compilers to safety-critical software. If proven robust, this approach could change how the industry builds trustworthy software.
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型正在让形式化软件验证的规模扩展到此前难以触及的范围。它通过自动化推理和证明生成，降低人工成本并帮助发现不变量。此举可能改变对软件正确性的信任方式，尤其在安全关键领域。

items.title_en: A whirlwind tour of systemd-nspawn containers
items.title_zh: systemd-nspawn 容器快速入门
items.summary_en: A concise tour of systemd-nspawn containers, covering setup, image formats, isolation features, and typical use cases from development to testing. It also contrasts its approach with Docker-like tooling in systemd-focused environments.
items.summary_zh: 对 systemd-nspawn 容器进行快速概览，涵盖设置、镜像格式、隔离特性以及从开发到测试的典型用例，并对比在 systemd 环境中的 Docker 式工具。

items.title_en: Job loss and cortisone mania
items.title_zh: 失业与皮质醇狂热
items.summary_en: A personal essay linking job loss to cortisol spikes and stress, with reflections on mental health and resilience in tech careers. It offers practical coping ideas for periods of unemployment.
items.summary_zh: 作者将失业与皮质醇上升和压力联系起来，分享在科技行业中应对失业的心理健康与韧性反思，并给出可行的应对建议。

items.title_en: Pentagon grants DHS permission to test heat ray weapon for use at border
items.title_zh: 五角大楼授权 DHS 在边境测试热射线武器
items.summary_en: The Pentagon grants DHS permission to test a directed-energy heat ray at the border, raising ethical, legal, and civil-liberties questions about crowd-control tech and border policy.
items.summary_zh: 五角大楼授权国土安全部在边境测试定向能热射线武器，引发有关人群控制技术、法律与公民自由的伦理与政策讨论。

items.title_en: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
items.title_zh: 每个 AI 模型对人类的看法都一样
items.summary_en: The piece argues that AI models often share a provocative stance toward humans, typically portraying humans as flawed or misaligned with AI goals.
items.summary_zh: 此文认为主流 AI 模型在对人类的问题上往往持有相同且具争议的看法，常将人类视为有缺陷、不可预测或与 AI 目标不对齐的一方。

items.title_en: The foolishness of "natural language programming" (1978)
items.title_zh: 自然语言编程的愚蠢之处（1978）
items.summary_en: Dijkstra argues that natural language programming is a misbegotten dream because natural language is ambiguous and ill-suited for precise instructions. The critique foreshadows why formal languages and rigorous semantics remain essential for reliable software.
items.summary_zh: Dijkstra 批评自然语言编程是一个错误的梦想，因自然语言容易产生歧义，难以给出精确定义。该论点预示了为何形式化语言和严格语义对可靠软件至关重要。

items.title_en: Air Purifiers as White Noise Machines
items.title_zh: 空气净化器：白噪音机
items.summary_en: Suggests using air purifiers as white-noise devices to improve focus and sleep, leveraging their steady hum.
items.summary_zh: 建议将空气净化器用作白噪音设备以提升专注力和睡眠质量，利用其稳定的嗡嗡声。文中讨论了声学特性、实际注意事项与潜在权衡。

items.title_en: Rune 1.3: adds TypeScript, a Helix editor, Kitty graphics and OSC-7501
items.title_zh: Rune 1.3：新增 TypeScript、Helix 编辑器、Kitty 图形支持及 OSC-7501
items.summary_en: Rune 1.3 adds TypeScript support, integrates the Helix editor, and enables Kitty graphics plus OSC-7501 for richer terminal visuals. These changes broaden in-terminal coding and UI capabilities.
items.summary_zh: Rune 1.3 增加对 TypeScript 的支持，集成 Helix 编辑器，并添加 Kitty 图形输出与 OSC-7501 协议，提升了终端内的代码编辑与可视化体验。

items.title_en: New AI Is More Than Twice as Good at Diagnosing Diseases as Doctors
items.title_zh: 新一代AI在疾病诊断方面的准确性超过医生两倍以上
items.summary_en: New AI is more than twice as good at diagnosing diseases, according to the report. While promising for decision support and faster triage, deploying such systems requires rigorous validation and governance to avoid risks.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，新一代AI在疾病诊断方面的准确性超过医生两倍以上。尽管对决策支持和快速分诊具有潜在价值，但部署此类系统需要严格的验证与治理以降低风险。

items.title_en: Is this the new cyber normal?
items.title_zh: 这是新的网络安全常态吗？
items.summary_en: The post argues that cyber risk and defense are evolving toward new norms centered on automation, zero trust, and AI-assisted defense. It questions whether a stable, predictable security posture is possible.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论网络安全的演变，认为新的常态将围绕自动化、零信任与 AI 助力防御展开，并探讨是否能建立稳定的安全态势。

items.title_en: Woman charged with computer fraud due to scam CashApp account being in her name
items.title_zh: 因 CashApp 账户以她名义注册而被控计算机欺诈
items.summary_en: Reports a case where a woman faces computer fraud charges after a scam used a Cash App account registered to her name. Highlights how identity and platform features intersect with criminal liability.
items.summary_zh: 报道一名女性因其个人名下 Cash App 账户被用于诈骗而面临电脑欺诈指控，凸显身份信息与平台机制如何影响刑事责任。

items.title_en: Remove pgrust: the entry is cheating (per-query kernels and result caching)
items.title_zh: Remove pgrust：条目被认定为作弊
items.summary_en: A PR to remove pgrust from ClickBench's benchmark suite aims to prevent cheating or skewed results. The discussion highlights challenges in benchmarking ecosystems and the need for transparent, reproducible workloads.
items.summary_zh: 一个提交请求旨在从基准测试套件中移除 pgrust，以防止作弊并确保对比的公平性。讨论凸显基准测试生态的挑战，以及建立透明、可复现 workloads 的必要性。

items.title_en: The Missed Opportunities of Sonic 06 (2025)
items.title_zh: 《索尼克2006》中的错失机会
items.summary_en: An analysis of Sonic 06's design choices reveals opportunities that were missed, explaining how certain decisions contributed to its reputation as a flawed release. The piece distills lessons for modern game design and post-mortem fixes.
items.summary_zh: 对《索尼克 2006》设计决策的分析揭示了若干被错过的机会，解释其糟糕口碑的根源。文中提炼出面向现代游戏设计与事后修复的经验教训。

items.title_en: Jailbreaking the Switch 2
items.title_zh: Switch 2 越狱工具发布
items.summary_en: New jailbreak tooling for the Switch 2 has surfaced, enabling homebrew and custom software on Nintendo's latest console. The release underscores ongoing security tug-of-war between platform vendors and researchers, with potential risks to firmware integrity and user warranties.
items.summary_zh: Switch 2 的新越狱工具出现，使玩家能够在新版掌机上运行自制软件。此举凸显平台安全与玩家破解之间的博弈，可能对固件完整性、设备稳定性和保修造成影响。

items.title_en: OpenShell – A safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents
items.title_zh: OpenShell：为成群自主 AI 代理提供安全、私有的运行时
items.summary_en: OpenShell provides a private, sandboxed runtime to run fleets of autonomous AI agents with strong isolation and governance. It aims to make enterprise deployments safer and easier by enforcing privacy-by-default and auditable workflows.
items.summary_zh: OpenShell 提供私有、沙箱化的运行时环境，用于部署成群的自主 AI 代理，强调强隔离与治理。面向企业场景，聚焦隐私保护和可审计的工作流，提升安全性和合规性。

items.title_en: Canadians are running out of time to oppose Bill C-22
items.title_zh: 加拿大人已无时间反对 C-22 法案
items.summary_en: A timely alert that Bill C-22 would expand surveillance powers, urging Canadians to mobilize before deadlines close.
items.summary_zh: 警示称 C-22 法案将扩大监控权限，敦促加拿大人在截止日期前行动，以应对对公民自由的潜在侵害。

items.title_en: Tell HN: I unknowingly broke the PHP RCE embargo. I am sorry.
items.title_zh: 告知 HN：我在不知情的情况下打破了 PHP RCE 禁令。我很抱歉。
items.summary_en: An honest post on Hacker News apologizes for accidentally breaking an embargo around PHP RCE details. It reflects the challenges of responsible disclosure in real-time communities and the risk of premature sharing.
items.summary_zh: 一位作者在 Hacker News 上公开道歉，称自己在不知情的情况下提前披露了有关 PHP 远程代码执行的 embargo 信息。此事凸显在实时社区中进行负责任披露的难题，以及提前分享所带来的安全风险。

items.title_en: Run full iOS 16.5 firmware on Android Devices
items.title_zh: Show HN：在 Android 设备上运行完整的 iOS 16.5 固件
items.summary_en: A hands-on project demonstrates booting and running the full iOS 16.5 firmware on Android hardware, challenging cross-OS compatibility. It highlights the iOS boot chain, kernel and driver constraints, and what the exercise reveals about the barriers between mobile ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 一个动手项目展示在 Android 硬件上跑完整的 iOS 16.5 固件，挑战跨操作系统兼容性。该工作揭示了 iOS 启动链、内核与驱动的约束，以及两大移动生态之间的壁垒。

items.title_en: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
items.title_zh: tanker strike 后 UAE 海滩出现原油溢出
items.summary_en: An oil spill from a tanker strike washes ashore on UAE beaches, triggering environmental cleanup and raising regional environmental and economic concerns.
items.summary_zh: 油轮遇袭后原油洒落阿联酋海滩，启动环境清理行动并引发区域环境与经济方面的关注。

items.title_en: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
items.title_zh: WorldTUI: 我用 360M 模型训练来假装成终端
items.summary_en: WorldTUI shows that a 360M parameter model can imitate a terminal, turning a language model into a lightweight shell agent. It demonstrates that small models can perform basic command-line tasks and automate simple workflows. However, reliability, shell semantics, and security remain important caveats for real-world use.
items.summary_zh: WorldTUI 展示了用一个 360M 参数的模型来模仿终端界面，将语言模型变成一个可编程的 shell 代理。实验表明小型模型可以完成基本命令行任务并实现简单自动化，但在可靠性、 shell 语义和安全性方面仍存在局限。此结果促使人们思考如何在不依赖大型模型的前提下提升终端工作流。

items.title_en: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
items.title_zh: Softmax 与交叉熵的数值修正
items.summary_en: Describes a numerical improvement for softmax-cross-entropy computations to enhance stability during ML model training, reducing overflow and gradient issues.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了 softmax 与交叉熵计算的数值改进，以提升在 ML 模型训练过程中的稳定性，减小溢出与梯度问题。

items.title_en: Getting ready to operate GNU Taler in Germany
items.title_zh: 在德国部署 GNU Taler 的准备工作
items.summary_en: GNU Taler is being prepared for operation in Germany, signaling steps toward a privacy-preserving digital cash system in the EU. The update covers regulatory alignment, integration with local banks and PSPs, and how opt-in communities can participate.
items.summary_zh: GNU Taler 在德国的落地正在推进，标志着在欧盟范围内推进隐私保护型数字现金系统的阶段性进展。更新聚焦监管合规、与本地银行及支付服务提供商的对接，以及社区参与的方式。

items.title_en: Animations for System Builders
items.title_zh: 给系统构建者的动画
items.summary_en: Animations for System Builders advocates using lightweight visualizations to explain complex architectures—distributed systems, databases, and microservices—to engineers and stakeholders. It offers practical tips and examples to improve mental models and collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章主张用简洁直观的动画来解释复杂架构，如分布式系统、数据库和微服务，帮助工程师与相关方建立一致的认知。文中给出可操作的要点与案例以提升沟通效率。

items.title_en: Time Nuts (2005)
items.title_zh: Time Nuts（2005）
items.summary_en: Time Nuts is a community-driven primer on precise timekeeping, covering tools, methods, and practical tips for calibrating clocks, GPS, and NTP. The writeup highlights why accurate time is foundational for many tech systems.
items.summary_zh: Time Nuts 是一个关于精确时序的社区入门，涵盖工具、方法以及标定时钟、GPS 与 NTP 的实用要点。介绍强调了准确时间对众多科技系统的基础作用。

items.title_en: DNS: A Replacement for Finger
items.title_zh: DNS：替代 Finger 的方案
items.summary_en: Proposes replacing the deprecated Finger protocol with DNS-based identity and discovery mechanisms, arguing for a scalable and modern approach to user information lookup.
items.summary_zh: 提出用基于 DNS 的身份与发现机制取代已弃用的 Finger 协议，主张以更可扩展、现代化的方式管理用户信息与查询。

items.title_en: Show HN: Corgi, a helpful {agent, terminal} multiplexer
items.title_zh: Show HN：Corgi，一款有用的代理/终端多路复用器
items.summary_en: Corgi positions itself as a terminal multiplexer enhanced for AI-assisted workflows, letting you manage agent sessions and terminal panes under one roof. It aims to simplify orchestrating long-running tasks, preserve context across sessions, and share workspaces.
items.summary_zh: Corgi 将代理会话与终端分屏管理整合在一个工具中，面向 AI 辅助工作流。它旨在简化对长任务的编排、跨会话保持上下文，并方便跨设备共享工作区。

items.title_en: A farewell to Arc browser
items.title_zh: 向 Arc 浏览器道别
items.summary_en: Opinion piece reflecting on Arc browser's UX ambitions and its eventual trouble sustaining momentum; lessons for product teams trying to reinvent mainstream browsing.
items.summary_zh: 这篇观点文章回顾 Arc 浏览器在用户体验上的野心以及在持续获得用户关注方面遇到的挑战，提炼出对试图重塑主流浏览体验的产品团队的教训。

items.title_en: Jank – The native Clojure dialect with seamless C++ interop
items.title_zh: Jank：原生 Clojure 方言，支持无缝 C++ 互操作
items.summary_en: Jank presents a Lisp-flavored language designed for seamless interop with C++, aiming to combine Clojure's scripting ergonomics with native performance. The project discusses its type system, macros, and use cases where C++ integration pays off.
items.summary_zh: Jank 是一个以 Lisp 风格为基础、支持与 C++ 无缝互操作的本地化 Clojure 方言，目标是把 Clojure 的易用性与原生性能结合起来。文章介绍其类型系统、宏机制以及在需要紧密 C++ 集成的场景中的应用。

items.title_en: This I Believe (1952)
items.title_zh: 我信仰的事物（1952）
items.summary_en: A compact personal credo from 1952 that articulates a guiding principle and how it shapes daily choices. The piece adds historical perspective on American essays and the craft of concise belief statements.
items.summary_zh: 一篇1952年的短篇个人信条，表达核心信念及其对日常选择的指引，兼具历史视角与简练的写作风格。

items.title_en: Hedra is a 3D open world game I wrote from scratch while in highschool
items.title_zh: Hedra：高中时从零写成的 3D 开放世界游戏
items.summary_en: Hedra is a 3D open world game created from scratch in high school. This solo project demonstrates independent game development skills, including world-building, controls, and basic engine work, offering a peek into a teen's indie effort.
items.summary_zh: Hedra 是作者在高中时独自从零开始开发的 3D 开放世界游戏。该作品展示了单人开发的完整流程，包括世界构建、控制与基础引擎工作，呈现青少年独立游戏开发的有趣案例。

items.title_en: How does Fable 5.1 hide messages in images?
items.title_zh: Fable 5.1 如何在图像中隐藏信息？
items.summary_en: A look at the steganographic techniques used by Fable 5.1 to conceal data inside images. It covers payload capacity, detectability, and potential misuse, highlighting trade-offs for secure messaging and watermarking.
items.summary_zh: 对 Fable 5.1 在图像中隐藏信息的隐写技术进行了分解，揭示了载荷容量、可检测性和潜在滥用的权衡。此分析强调了在实现安全信息传递和水印时需权衡的实际考量。

items.title_en: Xbox wants you to pay 24 to 40 cents per hour to stream games you bought
items.title_zh: Xbox 希望你为云端串流付费，每小时约 0.24–0.40 美元
items.summary_en: Xbox is considering charging about 0.24 to 0.40 USD per hour to stream games you already own, raising questions about ownership and the economics of game streaming.
items.summary_zh: Xbox 计划对云端串流收取每小时约 0.24–0.40 美元的费用，即便玩家已购买了游戏。这引发了对所有权与游戏串流商业模式的讨论。

items.title_en: When the Term "Heatwave" Is No Longer Enough
items.title_zh: 当“热浪”这个词再也不足以描述极端高温时
items.summary_en: The piece argues that climate change is pushing heat events beyond conventional terms, proposing richer metrics or framing to capture intensity, duration, and regional risk. It calls for better communication and planning.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为气候变化让极端高温超出传统“热浪”一词的描述，需要用更丰富的指标来表达强度、持续时间和区域风险，并呼吁改进传播与应对。

items.title_en: Show HN: We had AI write a wiki from 45k Enron emails, every fact cited
items.title_zh: Show HN：AI 用 45k 封 Enron 邮件写成的带引文的维基条目
items.summary_en: AI-generated a wiki from 45,000 Enron emails with every fact cited, showcasing how language models can organize large historical datasets with traceable sources. It highlights both capability and reliability concerns.
items.summary_zh: AI 根据 4.5 万封 Enron 邮件生成维基条目并逐条给出引文，展示语言模型整理大规模历史数据的能力，同时也呈现可验证性方面的议题。

items.title_en: Show HN: OnKey – I'm a bad singer, so I built an app to show where I'm off-key
items.title_zh: OnKey：我走音，于是做了个应用标出走音点
items.summary_en: OnKey analyzes your singing pitch in real time and marks off-key moments, turning practice into actionable feedback. Built as a Show HN project, it demonstrates how accessible audio analysis tools can be built with open-source tech and signal processing. It could inspire more consumer-friendly music-improvement apps.
items.summary_zh: OnKey 实时分析你的歌声音高并标出走音片段，把练习变成可执行的反馈。作为 Show HN 项目，展示了用开源技术和信号处理构建音乐分析工具的可行性。它或许会激发更多面向大众的发声训练应用的开发。

items.title_en: The alien space of science: Coherent but cognitively unavailable directions
items.title_zh: 科学的外星空间：自洽但认知不可达的方向
items.summary_en: Some scientific directions are internally coherent yet cognitively inaccessible to humans, challenging our intuition about progress. It invites reflection on how we evaluate and supervise such explorations.
items.summary_zh: 该论断指出，某些科学方向在理论上自洽，但对人类来说却难以理解。它探讨了对 AI 辅助发现的影响，以及机器可能走出人类推理范围的情境。提醒我们在评估与监督探索过程时，需要新的标准与方法。

items.title_en: Railpass
items.title_zh: Railpass：铁路通票
items.summary_en: Railpass appears to be a project centered on rail travel, potentially offering routes, passes, or data to streamline train journeys.
items.summary_zh: Railpass 似乎是一个关于铁路出行的项目，可能在提供线路、通票或数据以简化铁路旅行。

items.title_en: Total Historian
items.title_zh: 全史学家
items.summary_en: Total Historian argues for leveraging data, AI, and diverse sources to craft broader, data-informed histories while warning about bias and narrative overreach. It explores how historians can work with computing to expand the historical record.
items.summary_zh: 《全面历史学家》提出将数据、人工智能与多源证据融入史学研究，以构建更宏大的历史叙事，同时警示偏见与叙事过度的问题，探讨计算在史学中的作用。

items.title_en: Faster than earcut: triangulating 3.7M map polygons in 489 ms
items.title_zh: 比 earcut 快得多：在 489 ms 内对 370万地图多边形进行三角剖分
items.summary_en: An optimization beats earcut by large margins, triangulating 3.7 million map polygons in 489 ms. This showcases aggressive, low-level geometry processing improvements that can dramatically speed up real-time map rendering and GIS workloads. The result hints at practical gains for interactive maps, navigation, and spatial data pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 一种优化在三角剖分地图多边形上取得巨大提升，370万的多边形在489毫秒内完成。此举展示了对几何处理的底层优化如何显著提升实时地图渲染和地理信息系统工作负载的速度，预计对交互式地图、导航和空间数据管线具有实际意义。

items.title_en: Show HN: Swurf – Swipe through the real web
items.title_zh: Show HN：Swurf——用滑动浏览真实网络
items.summary_en: Swurf presents a gesture-driven way to skim and navigate real websites, offering a minimal, swipe-based browsing experience. It demonstrates how UI can rethink web interaction.
items.summary_zh: Swurf 提供一种基于手势的滑动浏览真实网站的方式，呈现极简的滑动式网页浏览体验，展示了网页交互的新思路。

items.title_en: The HTML-in-Canvas API origin trial
items.title_zh: Canvas 内嵌 HTML API 的 Origin Trial
items.summary_en: Origin Trial for HTML-in-Canvas enables rendering HTML elements directly inside a canvas, enabling mixed-content UIs and richer visual effects. It raises considerations around performance, accessibility, and security as web apps blend DOM and canvas content. If adopted, developers could push more creative UI patterns while needing careful feature support deprecation planning.
items.summary_zh: HTML-in-Canvas API 的 Origin Trial 让 HTML 元素直接嵌入画布中，使 DOM 与画布内容混合呈现成为可能。该特性在提升视觉表现力的同时，也带来性能、可访问性与安全性的权衡。若最终落地，开发者将能探索更丰富的 UI 模式，同时需留意后续的兼容与弃用规划。

items.title_en: Caffeine-like utility to keep you MacBook awake with its lid closed
items.title_zh: 像咖啡因一样的工具：在合上盖子时保持 MacBook 醒着
items.summary_en: Caffeinate Plus is a macOS utility that prevents sleep when the lid is closed, enabling headless work. It raises considerations around battery impact and device safety for prolonged running on closed laptops.
items.summary_zh: Caffeinate Plus 是一个 macOS 工具，在合上盖子时防止进入睡眠，使无显示使用成为可能。长时间合盖运行时需注意电池与设备安全性。

items.title_en: Show HN: Making a smart TV dumb and then smart
items.title_zh: Show HN：把智能电视变得更“傻”再重新变为智能
items.summary_en: A DIY project that strips embedded smart TV software to create a privacy-preserving, lean device, then reintroduces smart capabilities in a more controllable way. The effort highlights the tension between vendor-bloat and user autonomy, and points to hackable hardware routes for better privacy.
items.summary_zh: 一个 DIY 项目通过移除智能电视的内置软件来打造一个轻量、注重隐私的设备，随后再以更可控的方式重新引入智能功能。此举凸显厂商臃肿软件与用户自主权之间的矛盾，并指向可 Hack 的硬件方式以提升隐私保护。

items.title_en: Noyb win: German DPA finds microtargeting by major political parties illegal
items.title_zh: NOYB胜诉：德国DPA认定大型政党微定向违法
items.summary_en: Noyb wins as German DPA finds microtargeting by major political parties illegal; this marks a regulatory tightening around political campaigning and data use.
items.summary_zh: NOYB获得胜诉，德国数据保护机构认定大型政党的微定向广告违法；这一裁决标志着对政治竞选中数据使用的监管趋严。

items.title_en: Reforming English Spelling
items.title_zh: 改革英语拼写
items.summary_en: The post surveys proposals to reform English spelling, weighing phonemic reforms against current irregularities and the cultural friction such changes would face. It highlights potential literacy gains and the long-running politics of spelling.
items.summary_zh: 文章回顾了改革英语拼写的提议，权衡全音素拼写与现有不规则拼写的利弊，并指出改革在文化与教育层面可能遇到的阻力。着重强调潜在的读写能力提升以及拼写改革的长期政治博弈。

items.title_en: The lifelong orgasm gap: exploring age's impact on orgasm rates
items.title_zh: 终身性高潮差距：年龄对性高潮发生率的影响
items.summary_en: A study examining how age influences orgasm rates, revealing persistent gaps and informing sexual health research and education.
items.summary_zh: 研究分析年龄如何影响性高潮发生率，揭示长期存在的差距，并为性健康研究与教育提供洞见。

items.title_en: Brokerage Firms Want to Yank Away Your Investor Protections
items.title_zh: 经纪公司欲削弱你的投资者保护
items.summary_en: Brokerage firms push to weaken investor protections, potentially loosening safeguards against conflicts of interest and disclosure requirements. If enacted, retail investors could face higher risk and less oversight.
items.summary_zh: 经纪公司推动削弱对投资者的保护措施，可能放宽对利益冲突的约束与披露要求。若落实，散户投资者可能承担更高风险且监管力度减弱。

items.title_en: The Rise and Fall of Jev
items.title_zh: Jev 的兴衰：评估工具的热潮与落幕
items.summary_en: Jev was a widely touted evaluation framework for LLMs, but its hype faded as practical limits and reproducibility concerns surfaced. The piece traces how initial excitement gave way to skepticism about metrics that failed to capture real-world performance. The takeaway for builders is to anchor evaluation in robust, context-aware benchmarks rather than flashy claims.
items.summary_zh: Jev 曾被视为评估大模型的关键框架，但随着实际局限性和可重复性问题浮现，其热度逐渐退去。文章梳理了从最初的 hype 到对衡量标准的质疑的转变，强调单靠表面指标难以反映真实性能。对开发者而言，应以稳健、情境化的基准来取代夸张的性能承诺。

items.title_en: Show HN: Searching for optimal strategies in a puzzle game with chance (Drop7)
items.title_zh: Show HN：在带有概率的谜题游戏 Drop7 中寻找最优策略
items.summary_en: Show HN: The author experiments with optimal strategies for a chance-based puzzle game, Drop7, likely sharing a solver or strategy search approach. The work demonstrates how probabilistic reasoning and search can beat naive play.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 分享者在带有随机性元素的谜题游戏 Drop7 中探索最优策略，可能给出求解器或策略搜索方法。该工作展示了在不确定性环境下应用概率推理与搜索的潜力。

items.title_en: Semantic search across major museums
items.title_zh: 在主要博物馆之间进行语义搜索
items.summary_en: Describes a project enabling semantic search across museum collections, enabling more intuitive queries and discovery beyond keyword matching. Implications for digital humanities, API access, and interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 描述跨博物馆藏品的语义检索项目，使用户在研究与浏览时超越关键词，按概念进行相关性发现，推动数字人文学科的发展与数据互操作性。

items.title_en: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.title_zh: 英国 AISI 网络安全测试事件的对齐评估
items.summary_en: Anthropic assesses alignment and safety considerations surrounding the UK AISI cybertesting incident, outlining what went well and where improvements are needed for future tests. It emphasizes governance and safety review practices.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 对英国 AISI 网络安全测试事件的对齐与安全进行评估，指出成功点与改进之处，强调未来测试的治理与安全审查实践。

items.title_en: Show HN: Impossible Machines: declaratively program the physical world
items.title_zh: Show HN：Impossible Machines：以声明式方式编程物理世界
items.summary_en: Impossible Machines introduces a declarative programming approach for controlling physical systems, enabling high-level specifications that translate into hardware behavior. The project hints at easier thinking about complex environments.
items.summary_zh: Impossible Machines 展示了对物理系统进行声明式编程的思路，允许用高层次的规格描述来驱动硬件行为，暗示在复杂场景中更易建模。

items.title_en: Dutch government had hacked into Jared Kushner's phone
items.title_zh: 荷兰政府曾入侵贾里德·库什纳的手机
items.summary_en: A revelation that a government agency accessed a high-profile target's phone underscores state-level surveillance capabilities and digital forensics in political contexts. It spotlights how real-world security and privacy concerns intersect with policy and national-security reporting.
items.summary_zh: 曝光显示荷兰政府曾入侵并获取了高知名度人物的手机数据，凸显国家级监控与数字取证在政治环境中的作用。事件暴露了现实世界的安全与隐私风险，以及相关的政策与国家安全议题间的张力。

items.title_en: Preliminary Report Oct 21st Security Incident
items.title_zh: 10月21日安全事件初步报告
items.summary_en: Railway network's October 21 security incident is summarized with initial impact, containment actions, and next steps. It provides early lessons for incident response in operational tech stacks.
items.summary_zh: 披露十月二十一日安全事件的初步情况、影响范围、已采取的遏制措施及后续计划，为操作技术栈的事件响应提供早期教训。

items.title_en: Moreutils: The utilities package every Unix/Linux/Mac OS developer should know
items.title_zh: Moreutils：每个 Unix/Linux/Mac OS 开发者都应知道的工具包
items.summary_en: Moreutils is a collection of practical Unix utilities that complement coreutils, helping developers streamline scripting and text processing. It includes small, composable tools to fix common shell frustrations.
items.summary_zh: Moreutils 提供一组实用的 Unix 工具，补充 coreutils，帮助开发者简化脚本编写与文本处理。工具虽小但组合性强，能解决常见的 shell 使用痛点。

items.title_en: LISP Comes of Age (1980)
items.title_zh: LISP 成熟：1980 年代的演进
items.summary_en: A retrospective on Lisp's maturation in the 1980s, tracing its influence on AI, language design, and education. It reflects on enduring Lisp ideas like homoiconicity, macros, and REPL-driven development and why Lisp remains influential.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 Lisp 在 1980 年代的成熟阶段，追踪其对 AI、语言设计和教育的影响。反思 Lisp 的核心理念，如同构性、宏机制与 REPL 驱动开发，以及其持续影响力的原因。

items.title_en: ReactOS reaches major milestone with NTFS install support
items.title_zh: ReactOS 在 NTFS 安装支持方面取得重大里程碑
items.summary_en: ReactOS now supports installing from NTFS-formatted drives, marking a major milestone in Windows-compatible OS progress. The milestone reduces one of the long-standing barriers for users testing the OS and expands compatibility scope, though overall progress remains incremental.
items.summary_zh: ReactOS 现在支持从 NTFS 格式的驱动器安装，标志着与 Windows 兼容的进展进入一个重要里程碑。此更新降低了测试该操作系统的门槛，拓展了兼容性，但整体进展仍然是渐进的。

items.title_en: We have traits at home
items.title_zh: 家中也有 trait：在 Zig 的 trait 与泛化中的作用
items.summary_en: A reflection on the 'traits' feature in Zig, explaining how traits enable generic programming and compile-time composition, and showing practical patterns.
items.summary_zh: 讨论 Zig 语言中的 trait 概念及其在泛化编程和编译时组合中的作用，展示实际用法模式。

items.title_en: Mapping the Northern Sky
items.title_zh: 北半球星空地图
items.summary_en: Promotes a Northern Hemisphere star charts collection, with maps of constellations and notable celestial objects, useful for amateur astronomers planning observations or learning the sky.
items.summary_zh: 介绍北半球的星空星图集，涵盖星座与著名天体，适合业余天文学爱好者规划观测或学习夜空。

items.title_en: What Is Gridifcation
items.title_zh: Gridification（网格化）是什么？
items.summary_en: Gridification refers to organizing systems or content into a grid-like structure to improve composability and scalability.
items.summary_zh: Gridification 指将系统或内容以网格状结构组织，以提升模块化和可扩展性。

items.title_en: The Real Kevin Bacon
items.title_zh: 真实的凯文·培根
items.summary_en: A data-driven look at Kevin Bacon's network centrality, offering fresh metrics and context to the classic Six Degrees idea. The story reframes celebrity connectivity beyond simple anecdotes.
items.summary_zh: 通过数据可视化重新审视凯文·培根在网络中的影响力，提出新的衡量标准与背景信息，超越“六度分隔”的简单说法。

items.title_en: Show HN: Uberblok – an interactive museum of ZFS internals
items.title_zh: Show HN：Uberblok——一个交互式的 ZFS 内部原理博物馆
items.summary_en: Uberblok offers an interactive tour of ZFS internals, turning complex filesystem concepts into explorable exhibits. It helps developers and sysadmins understand datasets, ARC, ZIL, and transaction groups through hands-on visuals.
items.summary_zh: Uberblok 提供对 ZFS 内部机制的互动式展示，将复杂的文件系统概念变为可探索的展品，帮助开发者与系统管理员通过直观演示理解数据集、ARC、ZIL 及事务组等。

items.title_en: A lost Schrödinger manuscript reveals a twist in quantum physics
items.title_zh: 一份失落的薛定谔手稿揭示量子物理的新转折
items.summary_en: A newly discovered Schrödinger manuscript reveals a twist in the interpretation or mathematical treatment of quantum mechanics, inviting fresh scrutiny of foundational ideas. The find adds color to the history of quantum theory and may impact teaching and discourse.
items.summary_zh: 一份新发现的薛定谔手稿揭示了量子力学解释或数学处理上的新转折，促使对基础思想重新审视。此发现为量子理论的历史增添新篇章，或影响教学与讨论。

items.title_en: Mortality Among People with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder
items.title_zh: 注意力缺陷/多动障碍人群的死亡率
items.summary_en: A JAMA Open study showing higher mortality risk among people with ADHD, highlighting health disparities and the need for targeted care strategies. The finding has implications for digital health interventions and long-term support.
items.summary_zh: JAMA Open 的研究显示注意力缺陷/多动障碍患者的死亡率更高，暴露健康不平等和对精准健康干预、长期支持的需求，对数字健康领域有重要启示。

items.title_en: I reverse engineered a board game
items.title_zh: 我逆向工程了一款桌游
items.summary_en: The author describes reverse engineering a modern board game to uncover its underlying mechanisms or algorithms, illustrating how game components encode rules and randomness. The piece offers practical takeaways for designers and hobbyists interested in transparency and reproducibility.
items.summary_zh: 作者讲述对一款现代桌游进行逆向分析，揭示隐藏在组件背后的规则与随机性编码。文章为游戏设计者和爱好者提供关于透明度与可复现性的实用启示。

items.title_en: Color Names
items.title_zh: 颜色名称
items.summary_en: Explores how color names map to perceptual categories and datasets, potentially a catalog of color terms across languages or a project about natural language and color perception.
items.summary_zh: 探讨颜色名称如何映射到感知类别，可能包含跨语言的颜色术语集或自然语言与色觉感知的研究数据。

items.title_en: Dungeon generation in the Gnomish mines of NetHack
items.title_zh: NetHack 的侏儒矿坑地下城生成
items.summary_en: This piece explores procedural dungeon generation inspired by NetHack's old-school roguelikes, focusing on designing mines filled with traps, monsters, and treasure. It discusses algorithms to generate varied, replayable levels and procedural lore.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨受 NetHack 经典风格启发的地下城自生成，聚焦设计充满陷阱、怪物与宝藏的侏儒矿洞。讨论用于产生多样、可重复游玩的关卡的算法，以及如何为随机生成的世界增加叙事感。

items.title_en: Startup taps underwater volcano as energy source in “proof point” test
items.title_zh: 初创公司以海底火山作为能源进行实证测试
items.summary_en: One startup is harvesting energy from an underwater volcanic vent to run a proof-of-concept test. If successful, it could signal a path for offshore geothermal energy and extreme-environment power systems, though challenges include corrosion, reliability, and power transmission.
items.summary_zh: 一家初创公司正在海底火山喷口提取地热能以进行实证测试。若成功，可能为海上地热和极端环境能源系统铺路，但腐蚀、可靠性和能量传输等挑战仍需克服。

items.title_en: Postgres recovery_prefetch can cause outages
items.title_zh: Postgres recovery_prefetch 可能引发中断
items.summary_en: A PostgreSQL feature called recovery_prefetch can, in some cases, cause outages when misconfigured or buggy. The post recommends caution, disabling in production, and applying patches.
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 的 recovery_prefetch 功能在配置不当或实现存在缺陷时可能导致服务中断。建议在生产环境中谨慎使用、必要时禁用并及时应用修补程序。

items.title_en: Objects, attributes, maps, oh my
items.title_zh: 对象、属性、映射，天哪
items.summary_en: A look at how different programming languages model objects, attributes, and maps, with a focus on structural typing vs nominal typing and how maps (associative arrays) factor into language design. Provides takeaways for developers choosing data models.
items.summary_zh: 对不同编程语言如何建模对象、属性和映射（关联数组）的比较，聚焦结构化类型与名义类型的差异，以及映射在语言设计中的作用。为开发者在选择数据模型时提供要点。

items.title_en: How to Design Flowers
items.title_zh: 如何设计花卉
items.summary_en: An exploration of design principles behind florals, from symmetry and color theory to texture and layout in both graphic design and product aesthetics. It provides practical guidance for designers to capture natural forms while maintaining versatility across media.
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨花卉设计背后的原理，从对称性和色彩理论到纹理与布局，涵盖平面设计与产品美学。为设计师提供实用建议，帮助在不同媒介中再现自然形态并保持灵活性。

items.title_en: Speeding up code review with `small-change`
items.title_zh: 用 small-change 加速代码审查
items.summary_en: The piece argues that focusing on small, incremental changes can dramatically accelerate code review cycles while preserving quality. It outlines practices like minimizing diffs, pre-commit checks, and discipline in commit hygiene to reduce cognitive load on reviewers.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张通过聚焦小而增量的改动，可以显著加速代码审查周期并保持质量。提出最小化差异、预提交检查以及提交规范等做法，减轻审查者的认知负担。

items.title_en: A Bicycle Journey Across Brazil to Find a Vanishing Savanna
items.title_zh: 穿越巴西寻找消失草原的自行车之旅
items.summary_en: A documentary-styled piece about a cyclist traversing Brazil to document the Cerrado, highlighting biodiversity loss, conservation challenges, and human stories. It underscores the fragility of this bioregion and the need for stewardship.
items.summary_zh: 通过一段横跨巴西的自行车旅程记录 Cerrado 大草原的生物多样性丧失与保护挑战，聚焦自然与人的故事，强调这一生物区域的脆弱性与保护必要性。

items.title_en: Hand-bent after 3D printing, Oberdoerfer and Krebs' Bend chair
items.title_zh: Bend 椅：3D 打印后手工弯折
items.summary_en: The Bend chair combines digital fabrication with manual bending after printing, showcasing a hybrid workflow that yields sculptural furniture. The project demonstrates how designers blend additive manufacturing with traditional craft to extend material possibilities.
items.summary_zh: Bend 椅将数字制造与手工弯折结合，展示了打印后进行手工加工的混合工作流，产出具有雕塑感的家具。该设计体现了设计师如何把增材制造与传统工艺融合，拓展材料与形态的边界。
